sweep_recipe.notes:
CONTACT-CONDITIONED ARM D, 43-D = arm B's 39 channels plus the four foot_*_in_contact indicators. Seed 2026090702 (2 of 4).

NeRD's ablation puts removing the contact input at 19.8x on Ant, their floating-base walker -- the largest single factor in their table. It has never been testable here: every previous corpus wrote foot_*_in_contact as literal NaN in 100% of rows. go2_gravworld carries them populated, verified.

Measured motivation: arm B (39-D, observed gravity) cut the surrogate's action-response over-gain from 4.87x to 1.69x at 0.5s against arm A, while the permuted control C sat at 4.46x -- so the gain is the information, not the channel count. Contact is the next channel the model is blind to, on a system whose dynamics are dominated by making and breaking it.

FOUR seeds because downstream seed variance was 40% and arm A's two seeds differed by 304 of 536 episodes. Two is not enough to see an effect this size.
